summary: Stage 3 re-accepted after the one changed input, scenes.json (f3b1999757, RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_PYRE_CONTROLS_NO_BRIDGE_TOOL_CAN_RUN): six scene controls that no bridge tool could run were narrowed or removed, each with its reason in rules_out and a line in version/polish.md. No tree, sheet, floor or record decision changed; the Design Version 0.1.0 bars are untouched. Gate A lint PASS; designer_stage.py showcases accepts the set unchanged (burn_line 6, fire_cast 3, sky_and_shelter 3, fire_solace 3 new, overlap 0.25). Read of the two scenes left with control 'none': sc_ruins still rules out its leaf's false pass (inspect-text-only scorch) by reading footprint terrain, ProbeAsh depth and wall paint; sc_furnace_giant still reads the live race def and both spawned pawns' body sizes, so its 'size read from the XML' false pass rests on the live read, not a control. Neither needs a design change. The concept can go on to stage 4 and 5 as before.
